name: blockforge
description: A reusable, accessible, and performance-focused WordPress Gutenberg block toolkit.

scripts.plugin-zip: npm run build && rm -rf dist/package && rm -f dist/blockforge-0.1.0.zip && mkdir -p dist/package/blockforge && cp blockforge.php readme.txt LICENSE dist/package/blockforge/ && cp -R src build dist/package/blockforge/ && (cd dist/package && zip -r ../blockforge-0.1.0.zip blockforge) && rm -rf dist/package

author: Rashmi Ranjan Muduli
